The AgentTeams Worker agent image — the openclaw gateway runtime the
controller spawns for every Worker CR. Composes the shared
agentteams-openclaw candy (openclaw built from the pinned upstream
source commit) and the shared agentteams-cli candy (agt REST client +
mc), then installs the shared AgentTeams protocol libs
(/opt/agentteams/scripts/lib/) from the pinned AgentTeams source. The
charly-owned start-worker.sh sources those libs, pulls the worker
config (openclaw.json, SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, skills) from MinIO, starts
the file-sync loops, re-logins to Matrix for a fresh E2EE device, and
execs the openclaw gateway. The controller passes
HOME=/root/agentteams-fs/agents/<name> (hardcoded upstream) and the
worker's config/state all lives in MinIO (stateless), so the image
chmods /root to 755 (traversable by uid 1000) and pre-creates
/root/agentteams-fs + /root/.openclaw uid-1000-writable at build
time; the per-worker agents/<name> workspace is created at runtime.
Rootless: the service runs as the image user (uid 1000).
